item.title: commandline: Copilot to autopilot: Why no single safeguard is enough
item.description:
Microsoft says it built a layered control model for an AI agent to handle production network incidents autonomously, but only within defined identity, authorization, tooling, and human-approval boundaries. The article argues that no single safeguard is sufficient for production use.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
